claims.summary: `is_self_contained_bracketed_annotation` (lines 137-171) separates a side-note parenthetical from structure that must be kept.
claims.disposition: Verified against complete source at SHA 03c6b6de. The fn spans exactly L137-171 (doc L132-136). It returns true only for a chunk that opens with [ ( { and closes with the matching bracket at the chunk's end, trailing sentence punctuation tolerated. Line attribution exact.

claims.summary: The filter 'wants to ignore things like `(this is an aside)`' while preserving text that is not merely extra.
claims.disposition: Source contradicts the illustrative example, not the concern. Only a self-contained single whitespace chunk is skipped; `first_word_after_skipping_bracketed_annotations` splits on whitespace first, so a multi-word group is seen as '(this' and stops the scan. The predicate itself would accept the whole group if handed one — the boundary is chunk-scoped, not group-scoped. Pinned by a new regression; her concern is preserved.
